description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for serializing and deserializing JavaScript values, including handling of typed arrays, errors, dates, URLs, and other complex objects, used within the Playwright project.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Checks if an object is a RegExp instance.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Date instance.

methods.name: isURL
methods.description: Checks if an object is a URL instance.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if an object is an Error instance.

methods.name: isTypedArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is a specific typed array.

methods.name: isArrayBuffer
methods.description: Checks if an object is an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: typedArrayToBase64
methods.description: Converts a typed array to a base64 string.

methods.name: base64ToTypedArray
methods.description: Converts a base64 string to a typed array.

methods.name: parseEvaluationResultValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedValue into a JavaScript value.

methods.name: serializeAsCallArgument
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value into a SerializedValue for remote call arguments.
